narrative: The bill, on the bookwheel. A bill, read at the Theatre. The title is the whole of it. You do not turn toward the river. The bill, on the bookwheel. The bill stays a bill. The yard in front of you is this house, and it is not the Rose.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the bill at the Theatre and did not go.

entities.name: New World's Tragedy
entities.context: Shown on bill in Rose. New World's Tragedy
